_purpose: Pre-holdout architecture freeze manifest, V5 -- supersedes V4 for holdout-gating purposes. V1-V4 all preserved unmodified, not deleted, for chronology.

lineage.reason: initial pre-holdout freeze after closing the last two disclosed extraction limitations (scope, historical values)
resolved B3-002/B2-006 predicate semantics + third scope case + CandidateClaim architecture documentation -- no code changes
taxonomy #19 -- _UNAVAILABLE_MARKERS 'maintenance' collision, found via a new development case
taxonomy #20 -- unavailability red-team matrix found 2 real misses, opposite direction from #19

taxonomy #21 (FIXED) -- future-effective values lost diagnostic specificity, the symmetric gap to #18 in the future direction. Taxonomy #22 (BENCHMARK_ADAPTER_LIMIT_REACHED, disclosed, not fixed) found in the same tranche via the first real REVOKED exercise -- recorded, not patched, per the directive's own stop-rule.

why_a_v5_freeze_was_needed: Taxonomy #21: historical_values' collection and the gate's temporal pre-check both widened to include FUTURE_EFFECTIVE, fixing a real diagnostic-specificity loss (STATE_CONTRADICTION instead of TEMPORAL_CONTRADICTION) verified against a real corpus-grounded case (B5-001).
not_a_freeze_trigger_but_recorded: Taxonomy #22: values_match() compound-word fallback false-matches a value against a proper superset of its own word-set (e.g. AUTHORIZED_STANDING vs AUTHORIZED_STANDING_R2). Explicitly NOT patched -- BENCHMARK_ADAPTER_LIMIT_REACHED declared per directive Section 4. This does not change frozen gate/extraction CODE (values_match's existing logic is unchanged), it changes what's DOCUMENTED as its known limitation -- recorded here for completeness, not as a code-driving reason for V5. The actual code trigger for V5 is taxonomy #21 alone.

explicitly_not_frozen.cases*.json / documents*.json: dataset content -- documents_batch5.json/cases_batch5.json are Phase 5 tranche 2 (3 new DEVELOPMENT cases: B5-001..003), more tranches follow
explicitly_not_frozen.dataset_registry.py, LNES59_DATASET_MANI: infrastructure, updated every tranche by design
explicitly_not_frozen.test_*.py: test files grow with the dataset and with each red-team pass

gate._version_note: 2.1 = V1-V4 (values_match, INCOMPLETE carve-out, scope redesign, historical values). 2.2 = this freeze -- temporal pre-check widened to include FUTURE_EFFECTIVE (taxonomy #21). values_match() itself unchanged (taxonomy #22 disclosed, not patched).

extraction._version_note: 1.4 = V4 (taxonomy #20). 1.5 = this freeze -- historical_values collection widened to FUTURE_EFFECTIVE, and _resolve_temporal_status gained REVOKED detection via the new `revokes` document field (first real exercise, previously only hand-built in isolated gate tests).

candidate_claim_architecture._version_note: 0.1 = V2-V4. 0.2 = this freeze -- taxonomy #22 added as second concrete piece of motivating evidence (BENCHMARK_ADAPTER_LIMIT_REACHED section). Still design-only, not implemented.

regression_suite_state_at_freeze._total: 262/262, all green at the frozen commit -- DETERMINISTIC REGRESSION SUITE, not benchmark/blind accuracy

known_remaining_limitations_at_freeze: Taxonomy #17: sparse (2-word) NO_MATCH tokens whose negation marker doesn't survive the word-length filter remain vulnerable to a vague-hedge false match.

Taxonomy #22 (new): values_match() compound-word fallback false-matches a value against a proper superset of its own word-set (e.g. version/generation suffixes). Both #17 and #22 share the same root cause -- BENCHMARK_ADAPTER_LIMIT_REACHED, not fixed further, motivating evidence for the CandidateClaim boundary.
CandidateClaim architecture remains design-only (v0.2, still not implemented).
PREDICATE_ALIAS category remains unused in the corpus.
REVOKED detection (`revokes` field) has now been exercised once (B5-002) but not yet stress-tested for edge cases (e.g. a revocation that is itself later revoked, multiple competing revocations).
No B0-B4 baseline or full X0-X1 sweep has been run -- X2 remains the only arm with real empirical data.
